name: Return to Fel'Zerul
summary: In the Hinterlands, the Atal'ai Exile sends word to Fel'zerul in Stonard. The artifacts you brought are harmless, but the exile fears what Jammal'an the Prophet may do.

sections.title: Words from an Exile
sections.body:
The Atal'ai Exile once held Jammal'an the Prophet worthy of the high priesthood. Now the exile fears his unyielding faith in the prophecy may doom the Atal'ai, if it has not already. Speaking out earned the exile the name infidel and banishment from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

The artifacts you brought are harmless. Yet danger may lie in the summoning ritual, for Jammal'an may have found the right fetish enchantment. The world could be in great peril. Fel'zerul in Stonard waits to hear what the exile learned.

faq.q: Where must I go to speak with Fel'zerul?
Why was the Atal'ai Exile banished?
aliases: why is the exile in hinterlands
faq.answer: The Atal'ai Exile spoke against Jammal'an the Prophet's unyielding faith in his prophecy, which the exile fears may destroy the Atal'ai. The exile was called an infidel and banished from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

faq.q: Are the artifacts brought to the exile dangerous?
faq.answer: The exile says the artifacts are harmless. The danger lies in the summoning ritual and whether Jammal'an has found the right fetish enchantment for it.
